_README: config_opdiff.json -- the DEFAULTS file for the opdiff task (T-OD.3).
config.json <-> canonical_spec.json and config_language.json <->
canonical_spec_language.json are the two frozen pairs; the opdiff pair is
config_opdiff.json <-> canonical_spec_opdiff.json, and THE SPEC IS
DELIBERATELY UNFROZEN: every enforced field in it is null, which is what
makes the Gate 0 proxy guard REFUSE an opdiff run that claims
'canonical_opdiff_b'. That is the intended direction of failure -- the
protocol has not been ratified from measurement yet -- so every opdiff run
is stamped experiment_group=exploratory, and the numbers may be tabled as
long as the table says the protocol was not frozen.
Every training/model value mirrors config_language.json (the proven LM
setup on this hardware) except the data block. Specifically:
batch_size 48 -- the T-L7.0 measured ceiling on the 3050 was set by MoR
at ffn_mult 24 with 256-token rows; opdiff rows are 384 tokens (+50%
activation) and the router is 7 experts wide, so the opdiff smoke run
(T-OD.4) re-verifies headroom BEFORE the matrix. 48 is the hypothesis,
not a frozen protocol value.
epochs 3 -- a PROPOSAL pending the T-OD.5 budget approval, not a
convergence claim. The dataset is 110.7M tokens/epoch; changing this
number before the pilot changes nothing about an already-approved
run, because no canonical opdiff run exists yet.
routing_balance 0.001, halting 0.001 -- language's frozen balance
(T-L7.1), carried over as a STARTING POINT and not as a measured
value: the opdiff task loss is a masked cross-entropy over answer
digits, which is a different regime from both the arithmetic MSE and
the language 8192-way cross-entropy.
step_routing 0.0 -- DECLARED here, and NOT forced by the task block:
an opdiff row DOES carry a whole-row group label, so a non-zero value
is a well-defined, LABELLED oracle-routing ablation (resolve_variant
stamps it 'oracle_routing' and it may never share a table with an
unsupervised run). It is 0.0 here because the unsupervised router is
the arm the study is about.
family_cls is ABSENT on purpose -- a copied arithmetic 0.5 there is
REFUSED, see _apply_opdiff_block. The group probe is detached, and on
opdiff a non-zero weight would be a LIVE supervision signal on the
oracle partition, which is the confound this study exists to exclude.
data block: vocab_size 37 and seq_len 384 are MEASURED from
opdiff_v4/meta.json by make_opdiff_dataset_v4.py (19 fixed tokens + 18
op tokens; 16 x 24 = 384). opdiff_root is relative to the REPO ROOT and
may be overridden per-run with --opdiff_root (smoke runs use
opdiff_v4_smoke). dataset_version / train_split_version are STAMPED from
meta.json by stamp_opdiff_dataset_versions -- writing them here would be
a declaration about bytes on disk rather than a measurement of them.
